s.note: crumbed prawns, because Jabba eats frogs live
s.how: Butterfly 500g peeled green prawns. Dip in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 100g panko. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden. Drain and serve hot with sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges for squeezing.

Toss 250g strawberries, halved, 125g blueberries and 200g pitted cherries with 1 tbsp honey and torn mint. Whip 250g mascarpone with another spoon of honey until soft. Serve the fruit in a bowl with the mascarpone alongside.

m.note: roast chicken with a honey glaze, Han was almost on the menu
m.how: Spatchcock a 1.8kg chicken and lay over 800g potatoes and 4 carrots cut into chunks. Roast at 220C for 40 minutes. Brush with 3 tbsp honey warmed with 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme for the last 10 minutes. Rest and pull apart to share.

w.note: moss green, like the forest floor
w.how: Blitz 150g pistachios fine. Whisk 3 eggs with 200g sugar, then 150ml olive oil, then fold in the pistachios and 150g self-raising flour. Bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Dust the top with 1 tsp matcha mixed with crumbs for moss and add berries.

d.how: Blend 800ml cold milk with 200g frozen pineapple, the juice of a lime and half a tsp blue spirulina until smooth and pale blue. Pour into four glasses and drink straight away, before the Ewoks get it.
